description: Customer asks about an order that has not shipped. Greetings and routine questions only; nothing to extract.

messages.text: Hi, good morning. I ordered the two office chairs last week and wanted to check if they've shipped yet?

Sure its ORD-48213. no rush, just planning to be home when it arrives
